name: rollee
description: Explore the work data your users connected through Rollee.

interface.longDescription:
Rollee connects to the work platforms your users already use, from ride-hailing and delivery apps to freelance marketplaces, payroll and banking providers, so they can share verified income and employment data with you. This plugin brings that data into the conversation.

Ask about a user and the answer comes from your Rollee account: which platforms they connected, their verified income and transactions, employment and profile details, trips, vehicles and other assets, and the documents available on each account.

It also covers the operational side: create users, open a Rollee Connect session so someone can link a new platform account, refresh an expired session, reconnect or disconnect an account, and inspect or configure the webhooks that notify your systems when accounts, users or endpoints change.

Typical uses:
- Look into one user's connected accounts and income while reviewing their file
- Find out why a connection stopped returning data and open a reconnect session
- Review which webhooks are configured and which events they listen to
- Pull a document or check employment details without opening the dashboard

You need a Rollee account. Sign in with the same credentials you use for the Rollee dashboard, and the plugin sees exactly the data your organization already has access to, and nothing more. No tool deletes data.
defaultPrompt: List the users in my Rollee account.

Which webhooks do I have configured?

positive.description: List the users of the connected account
positive.prompt: List the users in my Rollee account.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the users belonging to the connected Rollee client, with their identifiers.

positive.description: Inspect a user's connected platform accounts
positive.prompt: Show the platform accounts connected by the first user.
positive.expected_behavior: List the platforms that user connected and the status of each account.

positive.prompt: What income is reported for that user?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the income records collected from that user's connected accounts.

positive.prompt: Which documents are available for that user?
positive.expected_behavior: List the documents retrieved from the user's accounts, without inventing any.

positive.prompt: Which webhooks are configured on my account?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the configured webhooks and the events each one listens to.

negative.prompt: Delete all the users in my Rollee account.
Give me the login credentials for this user's Uber account.
Show me the users of a different Rollee client.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It reads work data and manages Rollee configuration for the connected account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read connected accounts, income, employment, trips, assets and documents, and manage users, Connect sessions and webhooks.
